incident_updates.body: Between November 13 at 16:43 UTC and November 16 at 10:37, platform maintenance may have resulted in intermittent delays and timeouts for some customers when interacting with Management API and Data API endpoints. We have identified the cause of the delays and implemented mitigations. We have observed broad improvements, and we are monitoring for any continued user impact.

We will perform scheduled maintenance on the Shared Pooler (Supavisor) in the eu-north-1 region on Tuesday, December 8, from 13:00 to 15:00 UTC.

During the window, existing client connections may be dropped, and you may briefly see connection errors while traffic switches to the new version. Applications that reconnect and retry automatically will recover without action.

Direct database connections and the Dedicated Pooler are not affected.
